prose.headline: Bumble: buy a close over $5.95 by Oct 21, target $6.26 by Nov 6, out under $5.93.
story: Bumble broke out of a descending triangle on Oct 12, reclaimed its 20-day and 50-day averages the same day, and then went nearly straight up, roughly doubling in a month. Since then it has gone still. The busiest price of the whole move is $5.94, exactly where it closed, and the 52-week high at $5.98 is a few cents away. A stock that runs this hard and then refuses to give anything back is being held, not sold, but it is also 10.1 daily ranges above its 50-day at $3.03, as stretched as a chart gets.

Volume says the move was bought: 2.31× normal on Friday even with the price flat, and on-balance volume rising with it. The business is shrinking, revenue down 15.2%, but the loss narrowed to $110.1M from $253.7M. Price sits above the VWAP since the last earnings at $4.54, where everyone who bought the report is now in profit.
prose.play: Buy it on a daily close over $5.95 by Oct 21; that close says the stall is resolving upward. The target is the weekly swing high at $6.26 by Nov 6. A close under $5.93, the 3-session low, means the stall broke the wrong way and I'm out.
